messages:
mia_support: Heads-up — ticket #5552 (AcmeCorp). On mobile Safari the analytics dashboard shows legend colors that don't match chart slices, and tooltips show the wrong metric when tapping series. Embeddings usage card shows 0 for last 24h but API logs show calls. Screenshot: https://redwood.box/s/abc123 :eyes:

linda_support: Customer on iPhone 14 / iOS 16.4, Safari. They say issue started after yesterday's frontend deploy. Repro steps attached.

sophie_eng_frontend: Can you paste minimal repro steps + UA + build id? Also any console errors? I'll take a look. :mag:

mia_support: Steps I got from CS:
1) Login to console on iPhone Safari
2) Open Console > Analytics > Model Usage
3) Set range to "Last 24 hours"
4) Tap the legend entries to toggle series and tap a point to see tooltip
Observed: legend colors don't align with slices, tooltip shows "tokens_generated" for embeddings series.
User agent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_4 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
Build: web-frontend@2026.03.14-9d2f6
Screenshots: https://redwood.box/s/abc123

sophie_eng_frontend: thanks. Can you also paste network call for chart data? headers ok to mask. Example curl that should match what browser requests:
```
curl 'https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics/model_usage?range=24h&breakdown=series' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer <redacted>'
```

mia_support: Attached HAR in ticket and BUGTRACE: trace_id=trace-0a1b2c. Also seeing 500 for a metrics aggregation call intermittently.

alex_eng_sre: FYI re 500s — I'm seeing elevated 504s in the metrics ingestion proxy around 2026-03-14T22:10Z matching the deploy window. Linking traces: https://observability.redwood/trace/trace-0a1b2c :warning:

noah_eng_ml: Could be a mismatch between the frontend mapping (series id -> color) and the backend series ordering. If a delayed job reorders series, the legend could be rendering based on stale color map. I'll reproduce in staging with the same timestamped agg. Also the embeddings ingestion pipeline had a lag spike (billing pipeline fall behind) which explains the 0 usage in card — data delayed, not lost.

sophie_eng_frontend: I can reproduce the legend mismatch locally when charts receive series in different order between initial payload and websocket updates. Fix idea: bind color by series id rather than array index. I'll open PR and include a test covering websocket reorder.

mia_support: Customer asked for ETA and workaround. For now they can use desktop Chrome as workaround.

noah_eng_ml: ETA: I can confirm staging repro. Working on a hotfix for mapping logic. If acceptable, we can hotfix frontend and roll to canary tonight. Also will add guard to show a 'data delayed' banner for embeddings card when ingestion latency > 15m.

sophie_eng_frontend: PR: https://git.redwood/eng/frontend/merge_requests/472 — includes unit test and e2e for mobile Safari. Requesting canary after QA.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary to 10% of users — build web-frontend@2026.03.15-1a9c8 :rocket:

linda_support: Thanks team. I'll update customer: explain root cause (frontend color binding + ingestion lag) and ETA for canary + workaround (use desktop). Will follow up after canary results. :thumbsup:

alex_eng_sre: I'll keep an eye on proxy 5xxs and scale if we see more. Patch network timeouts for the ingest proxy as a follow-up.

noah_eng_ml: logging note: added extra context to embeddings ingestion to help correlate missing cards with lagging jobs. ticket: ML-1089

mia_support: closed loop with customer at 2026-03-15T02:20Z. They confirmed desktop workaround worked. Will reopen if regressions after canary.
